title: neonbeats
description: this mod ads a gui that you activate with  the "N" key and it lets you upload a mp4 file that plays instead of normal mc music
body:
NeonBeats

NeonBeats is a client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.11 that replaces Minecraft's ambient music with your own music library.

Bring your favorite soundtrack into Minecraft with a neon-inspired cyberpunk music player that can be opened at any time without pausing the game.

Features
Custom Music Library
Load MP3, OGG, and WAV files from a local neonbeats-music folder
Instantly rescan the folder to detect newly added tracks
Launch the music folder directly from the game
Cyberpunk Interface
Dark neon-themed UI with cyan, purple, and pink accents
Animated scanline effects
Corner-bracket styling inspired by futuristic HUDs
Smooth glowing controls and progress indicators
Playback Controls
Previous track
Play / Pause
Next track
Stop
Shuffle mode
Volume slider with live percentage display
Track progress bar with animated glowing indicator
Track Browser
Scrollable playlist
Display up to 10 tracks at a time
Click any track to start playback
Click the currently playing track to pause it
Minecraft Integration
Open the player at any time with the N key
Works entirely client-side
Suppresses Minecraft's vanilla background music while your music is playing
How To Use
Install NeonBeats for Fabric 1.21.11
Launch Minecraft once

Place your music files into:

minecraft-instance/neonbeats-music/

Start Minecraft
Press N
Click SCAN
Select a track and enjoy
Supported Formats
MP3
OGG
WAV
Requirements
Minecraft 1.21.11
Fabric Loader

Enjoy Minecraft with your own soundtrack.
